title: Harry Rositzke pulled out of retirement to run an unofficial counterintelligence operation

tellings.quote: they pulled him out of retirement to help run this unofficial operation against the Russians and Chinese or whoever else

plain: A writer on UFO history named Greg Bishop, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025, tells of Harry Rositzke, a retired American intelligence officer. Bishop says that in the late 1970s or early 1980s Rositzke was pulled out of retirement to help run an unofficial spy-catching operation against the Russians, the Chinese or other rivals. If true, it would mean hidden intelligence work was going on in the background of the strange events Bishop describes.
